daily.today_energy: Mercury's got your back today, Cap. This is your moment to trust the process and let your natural magnetism do the heavy lifting. Things are flowing in ways you didn't anticipate.
daily.love: Someone's noticing the quiet confidence you're radiating. Whether you're single or coupled up, authenticity is your love language right now. Don't overthink the small gestures.
daily.career: Your ideas hit different today. Share that project vision you've been sitting on—the timing feels aligned. Your ability to see the bigger picture is exactly what's needed in your space.
daily.health: Your body's asking for presence over perfection. Move in ways that feel good, nourish yourself with intention, and notice how much better you feel when you slow down intentionally.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is asking you to soften your edges, Cap. You've been grinding hard, and the cosmos is gently suggesting it's time to let people in. Vulnerability isn't weakness—it's your superpower right now.
weekly.love: Your people are craving more of you this week. Whether it's deepening existing connections or finally texting that person back, the universe is lowkey rooting for your heart to take center stage. Show up authentically.
weekly.career: Innovation is calling, but not in the way you'd expect. Instead of forcing results, try shifting your perspective on a current project. A fresh approach could unlock opportunities you didn't see before. Trust your instincts.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness this week. Skip the intense workouts and lean into restorative activities—yoga, long walks, whatever feels nourishing. Mental space matters just as much as physical movement right now.
